title: Paul Stamets is a snake oil salesman. | Facebook
abstract: # Mushroom Marauders | Paul Stamets is a snake oil salesman | Facebook. Criticism of lion's mane mycelium study results. ### **Paul Stamets is a snake oil salesman.**. In an attempt to prove that the mycelium of Lion's Mane outperforms the fruiting body, (he sells the mycelium, aka the ground up, spent substrate from his fruiting blocks), he set up a wildly inaccurate, clearly flawed "study". He was able to get the results he wanted by using two different methods of extraction, an ethanol extraction for the mycelium and a hot water extraction for the fruiting body, while claiming, in his own words, that "the science is sound". Ugh. Stamets lost credibility after hearing him on Joe Rogan years ago —anyone who brings him up to me (because I’m a forager/mushroom person) is steered to mycologists I respect & trust Image 5: ✌🏻Stamets lost his scientific way when fame & greed grew beyond the curiosity.
